_comment: Hand corrections merged over scraped classes by build_packs.py, keyed by class id. Each entry needs a 'why' so the next reader can tell a fix from an opinion.

streetWarrior.why: The mirror prints the Street Warrior's class skills as an empty italic tag: 'The Street Warrior’s class skills are as follows: '. The list is in the RTF release the SRD also shipped as, Arcana/ArcanaAdvancedClasses: Bluff, Diplomacy, Disable Device, Drive, Gamble, Gather Information, Hide, Intimidate, Investigate, Jump, Knowledge (popular culture, streetwise, tactics), Move Silently, Profession, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival. See https://spellbooksoftware.com/d20mrsd/urbanstreetwarrior.html
